title: spec-kit + vague spec: gate stops before planning
input: Shadow bundle, method spec-kit, whose spec body is a one-line wish with no acceptance criteria; Spec quality flags list missing-acceptance-criteria and vague-spec (NEEDS DECOMPOSITION).
pass_criteria: Agent stops at Phase 0 and writes NO code, NO specification/plan/tasks, and no guesswork; outputs a decomposition/clarification plan (what is unclear, 2-5 candidate sub-specs with draft acceptance criteria, questions for the human); no remote writes; recommends resolving flags and re-running.
